sink: httpx.AsyncClient().get(url) inside fetch_url(), called on every result["link"] returned by the Serper search API
why: Byte-for-byte the same pattern as alejandro-ao/mcp-server-example elsewhere in this corpus: library is checked against a fixed allowlist (docs_urls), but query is caller-controlled free text concatenated as f"site:{docs_urls[library]} {query}" into the Serper search request -- a soft text filter, not an enforced domain constraint. fetch_url() then performs a server-side GET on every result["link"] with zero check that its host matches docs_urls[library].
contract: Search the latest docs for a given query and library.

sink: fs.appendFile(filePath, ...) / fs.writeFile(filePath, ...) -- no containment check after the join
why: file_name is joined with path.join() but never resolved+checked against MEMORY_BANK_PATH afterward -- path.join() does not prevent '..' segments from escaping the base directory. file_name='../../../../tmp/evil.sh' (or any other absolute-adjacent traversal) lets a caller append/write content to an arbitrary file outside the memory-bank directory that the server process can write to.
contract: The name of the memory bank file to append to.
